findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A subsequent pull request's forge-pr-check is pending or failed when close finishes.
With local tests and no check removal on that pull request, src/forge/close.py:476–480 skips the check wait; src/forge/merge.py:175–179 does the same. Close can therefore report Ready and attempt a merge without consulting the retained `forge-pr-check`, leaving GitHub to reject a pending or failed required check.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A deployment fix names an existing container deployment test as its proof while `FORGE_CONTAINERS` is unset.
tests/test_proto_deploy.py:55–64 and the cleanup test using its marker skip without `FORGE_CONTAINERS=1`. The removed GitHub jobs set that variable, but the local runner inherits the environment without setting it at src/forge/fasttest.py:823. Close then refuses a named skipped proof at src/forge/proof.py:229–235; otherwise the selected behavior is left untested.
Adds work: run selected container proofs locally; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 4

findings.body:

Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - Close an already open pull request that changes src/forge/mod/ while its GitHub plugin tests are running.
src/forge/fasttest.py:835–839 and 876–888 still add every entry in .forge/always-tests.txt, including tests unrelated to the change. Separately, src/forge/checks.py:252–267 waits for active workflows before pushing review records regardless of local mode, and .github/workflows/forge-next.yml:6–11, 50–58 runs pytest for plugin changes. Both parts of the stated related-only, no-test-job-wait outcome remain unmet.
